title: crepis vesicaria subsp. bivonana
intro: Crepis vesicaria subsp. bivonana, commonly known as Bivon's Hawk's-beard or Crepis bivonana, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family, Asteraceae. This plant is known for its traditional use in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. Crepis vesicaria subsp. bivonana has been reported to possess several health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor activities.
